name: Bitter eggplant
summary: Purple bitter eggplant from Ba Na villages. Go Vietnam’s cluster article says it is grilled whole over charcoal, and also cooked as a soup with pork. The aftertaste it prints is sweet, after the bitter.
origin: Go Vietnam lists grilled bitter eggplant and bitter-eggplant soup among Ba Na specialties of the Kon Tum cluster.
taste: Go Vietnam prints a slightly bitter flavour with a sweet aftertaste.
howToEat: Grill the eggplant whole over charcoal, or eat the soup cooked with pork. The cluster article prints 50,000–80,000 VND a serving. A street and a clock were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Ba Na villages in the Kon Tum cluster, on that article.
priceBand: Go Vietnam’s cluster article prints 50,000–80,000 VND a serving.
